text:
sam_support: Heads up — BrightPay is seeing intermittent 429s this morning around ~12:30 UTC. They describe short bursts (~8-12 rps) and some requests return 429 with quota headers. Can we collect repro evidence (reqids, raw headers, curl) so we can correlate with our ingress logs?

maria_ops: Which request IDs do we have from them so far?

sam_support: Customer sent two client reqids: bp-req-20241110-1a2b3 and bp-req-20241110-1a2b4. They also included a raw response showing `x-rw-quota-remaining: 0` and `x-rw-quota-reset: 2`. Need our edge-request-ids to map.

devon_repro: Ask them to run a quick curl that returns headers. Example to give customer (they should redact tokens):
```
curl -i -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: bp-req-20241110-1a2b3' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"healthcheck"}]}'
```
Tell them to paste the full response headers and body for any 429s. Encourage `-v` or `-i` so we get headers.

alex_w: From our side we need the customer org id or client IP to grep the edge logs. I can search for `bp-req-` or their org `org_brightpay` and extract the edge IDs (rw-edge-req-*) and backend reqids.

maria_ops: Quick timeline skim from infra logs at 12:30 UTC: 12:30:12.412Z rw-edge-req-8781 -> 200, 12:30:13.017Z rw-edge-req-8782 -> 429 (x-rw-quota-remaining:0, x-rw-quota-reset:2s), 12:30:13.532Z rw-edge-req-8783 -> 429. Need customer curl/har to tie client reqids to these edge ids.

sam_support: Customer also reported retries — they have a client SDK that retries with no jitter. Ask them to include whether they performed retries and the exact timestamps for each attempt.

devon_repro: For repro advice, share a local burst replay command they can run (again redact token):
```
seq 1 10 | xargs -n1 -P10 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total} X-Request-ID: bp-burst-{}\n" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"burst test {}"}]}' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat'
```
This will show how many concurrent requests hit and which return 429.

alex_w: Once we have their curl output, I'll run an internal query to pull: timestamp, edge_reqid, backend_reqid, http_code, x-rw-quota-remaining, x-rw-quota-reset. Paste results as CSV so support can forward.

maria_ops: Please ask the customer to include these in their response: exact client timestamps (ISO format), the client IP (if available), the X-Request-ID values they set, and any client-side retry/backoff settings. A HAR of the browser SDK or tcpdump from their side is extremely useful but optional.

sam_support: Action items I'm sending to customer now: 1) run the `curl -i` repro with X-Request-ID per call, 2) collect any 429 response headers and paste them, 3) provide the list of timestamps and whether they retried, 4) if possible, run the burst replay we provided and paste output.

devon_repro: Internal note: if we observe x-rw-quota-remaining bouncing to zero within the same second for many requests, likely quota windowing. Recommend client-level smoothing (leaky-bucket) and configure server-side quota burst allowance if needed. I'll prepare a short guidance snippet once we confirm.

alex_w: I'll pull logs for 2024-11-10T12:30:11Z -> 12:30:15Z and post a mapping CSV: timestamp, client_reqid, edge_reqid, code, quota_remaining, reset_seconds. @maria_ops once we have that we can match to customer-provided X-Request-IDs.

maria_ops: Thanks — please also capture any autoscaling events on the Dedicated pool at that time, and any rate-limiter logs from the quota service.

sam_support: Good plan. I'll update the BrightPay ticket with the repro steps and the curl template. :thumbsup:
